ValidationRule.description: Only below changes are allowed for Coupon Status: 1) Created -> Distributed 2) Distributed -> Issued / Unissued but Voided 3) Issued -> Distributed / Used / Expired / Issued but Voided 4.No status is allow to be back to "New".
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: OR( AND( NOT(ISNEW()), ISCHANGED(Coupon_Status__c), TEXT(PRIORVALUE(Coupon_Status__c)) = "Created", NOT(ISPICKVAL(Coupon_Status__c, 'Distributed')) ), AND( NOT(ISNEW()), ISCHANGED(Coupon_Status__c), TEXT(PRIORVALUE(Coupon_Status__c)) = "Distributed", NOT(ISPICKVAL(Coupon_Status__c, "Issued")), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Coupon_Status__c, "Unissued but Voided")) ), AND( NOT(ISNEW()), ISCHANGED(Coupon_Status__c), TEXT(PRIORVALUE(Coupon_Status__c)) = "Issued", NOT(ISPICKVAL(Coupon_Status__c, "Used")), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Coupon_Status__c, "Issued but Voided")), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Coupon_Status__c, "Expired")) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Only below changes are allowed for Coupon Status: 1) Created -> Distributed 2) Distributed -> Issued / Unissued but Voided 3) Issued -> Used / Expired / Issued but Voided
